info.title: Etsy Shop Daily Sales Tracker & Scraper
info.description:
Daily sales for 370,000+ Etsy shops: sales per day, 7-day and 28-day sales and total sales, measured from each shop's public sales counter and dated. One row per shop, pay per shop.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity
Author: Public Records.
